title.narrative: Fiscal Strengthening for Inclusive Growth
Fortalecimiento Fiscal para el Crecimiento Inclusivo

description.narrative: El objetivo de esta serie programtica y de la primera operacin esfortalecer la sostenibilidad fiscal, protegiendo la inversin pblica y el financiamiento de programassociales para favorecer el crecimiento inclusivo. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar la eficiencia dela gestin fiscal (con especial nfasis en la eficiencia del gasto pblico); y (ii) mejorar la sostenibilidadprevisional.La presente operacin corresponde a la primera de dos operaciones bajo la modalidad de PrstamoProgramtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP), a conformarse de dos prstamos contractualmenteindependientes y tcnicamente vinculados.

The objective of this programmatic series and of this first operation is to strengthen fiscal sustainability, protecting public investment and social program funding to favor inclusive growth. The specific objectives are to: (i) boost the efficiency of fiscal management (with particular emphasis on the efficiency of public expenditure); and (ii) improve pension sustainability.This is the first of two Programmatic Policy-based Loans (PBPs), which will be contractually independent but technically related.
Commitment in 2018-06-13
Disbursement in third quarter of 2018
